Studio Deliverables

What I Offer for Authors & Publishers

From initial thumbnail sketches to finalized print-ready files and animated promotional teasers, here are the four core services I bring to your next children's literary project.

Core Craft
🎨

Storybook Illustration (Whimsical watercolor style)

Interior Double-Page Spreads

Full manuscript illustration crafted with traditional Winsor & Newton paints on Arches 300gsm cotton paper, professionally digitized into print-ready 300+ DPI master files.

  • ✓ 16 to 32 double-page storybook spreads
  • ✓ Character concept sheets & expression studies
  • ✓ Full-bleed panoramic watercolor illustrations
  • ✓ Spot illustrations & decorative chapter vignettes
  • ✓ 2 rounds of pencil layout revisions before ink & paint
📚

Storybook Cover Design

Hardcover & Paperback Wraps

Irresistible front covers that capture a child's eye from bookstore shelves, featuring bespoke hand-painted title lettering, foil accent templates, and complete spine-to-back wrap artwork.

  • ✓ Complete dust jacket & casewrap layouts
  • ✓ Hand-lettered watercolor title typography
  • ✓ Precise spine width & barcode integration
  • ✓ Spot-UV & gold foil overlay vector masks
  • ✓ Social media 3D book mockup renderings
🎬

Storybook Trailers

Cinematic Animated Teasers

Breathtaking 30 to 60-second animated video trailers that bring watercolor pages to life with gentle 2.5D parallax camera motion, floating light particles, and soothing soundtrack orchestration.

  • ✓ 30–60 second cinematic book trailer
  • ✓ 2.5D parallax layer animation of artwork
  • ✓ Floating golden dust & starlight particle FX
  • ✓ Ambient orchestral soundtrack & sound design
  • ✓ Formatted for YouTube, Instagram Reels & Kickstarter
🖼️

Comic Book & Graphic Novel

Sequential Watercolor Panels

Dynamic sequential art for early readers, middle grade, and family devotionals. Soft watercolor panel gutters, expressive character pacing, and hand-lettered speech bubbles that draw young readers in.

  • ✓ Sequential panel storytelling & pacing
  • ✓ Soft watercolor washes inside ink frames
  • ✓ Hand-lettered dialogue bubbles & captions
  • ✓ Early reader chapter book illustrations
  • ✓ Graphic novel spreads & character consistency

“To spread beauty, truth, and goodness.” — Studio Dedication Stone
Behind the Brush

Painting Stories for Little Hearts

Every brushstroke begins with quiet reflection. Whether illustrating a sacred gospel narrative, a dreamy bedtime sailing adventure, or a magical fairytale forest, my heartbeat is to create a safe sanctuary of light and tenderness for children and the grown-ups who read to them.

From my studio surrounded by morning birdsong, olive branches, and cups of warm spiced tea, I paint with traditional tube watercolors on Arches 300gsm cold-press cotton. Characters carry gentle kindness in their eyes, colors bloom like petals in water, and every story reminds little souls that they are safe and deeply cherished.

🖌️ The Traditional & Hybrid Worktable

Winsor & Newton Artists’ Watercolors Luminous, lightfast mineral pigments ground with natural gum arabic.
Arches 300gsm Cold-Press Rag 100% natural cotton rag with rough deckle edges for deep, organic texture.
Pure Squirrel Mop & Sable Brushes Holding wide, soft water glazes that feather gently across the paper.
Hybrid Procreate & After Effects For high-res publisher color separation and cinematic animated trailers.
